name: DEXAMETHASONE/PHENYLEPHHRINE/NEOMYCIN 15ML NASAL
description: It relieves inflammation (swelling, heat, redness, and pain) and is used to treat certain forms of arthritis; skin, blood, kidney, eye, thyroid, and bowel disorders (e.g., colitis); severe allergies; and asthma. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
